_about: D1a (docs/architecture/d1-roster-data.md section 3): identity, base stats, kit, the Rally rule and the finisher keys of one fighter, loaded by sim/core/fighter_data.gd into Fighter fields. Identity text is Narrative's (docs/narrative/identity.md); colours are Art's placeholders. finishers.base is the finisher template id in data/combat/finishers.json (form tiers come with F1). The id is the stable roster id (Fighter.id) and equals the folder name. Keys starting with '_' are comments: the canonical data hash skips them.
_identity: no words here: a fighter's displayed name, title and signature name are in ui/data/fighter_names.json, keyed by this id, and the sim never reads them (docs/architecture/pending/fighter-split.md section 9). In the sim his name is his id and his signature is the key <ID>.SIG

rally._note: the prototype fighters' placeholder rule (wounds-plan.md S4)

_sigCooldown: seconds before this fighter's signature can fire again (questionnaire 5: 2 to 4 signatures a match, each an event)
